title: The admin sidebar's areas
question: People has become a catch-all. Which way should the sidebar's areas be split? (1 of 4 on this page)

options.label: What you do most, first
options.thesis: Seven areas in the order staff reach for them: Sundays, This week, Ministries & groups, Safety, People & access, The app, Technical.
options.viewport: This week holds Calendar, Announcements, Weekly digest and Prayer; Safeguarding and Safe Ministry Check get their own Safety area; People and App review become People & access.
options.risk: Seven areas is two more than today, so more to fold.

options.label: Who it is for
options.thesis: Five areas named for who the work serves: Everyone at church, Groups & ministries, One person at a time, The app, Technical.
options.viewport: Everyone at church gathers sermons, the calendar, announcements and the digest; One person at a time holds People, Prayer, Safeguarding and Safe Ministry Check.
options.risk: Everyone at church becomes the new big drawer (five pages).

options.label: What you are doing
options.thesis: Seven areas, one kind of work each: Sundays & sermons, News & calendar, Ministries & groups, Chats & prayer, Safety & accounts, The app, Technical.
options.viewport: Weekly digest joins News & calendar; Chats sits with Prayer; People, Safeguarding, Safe Ministry Check and App review make Safety & accounts.
options.risk: Chats & prayer is a pairing staff might not look for.
